changes.name: The Saturday Ride (TSR)
changes.description: TSR, Scottsdale's big Saturday road ride. Same Gainey Village corner as the weekday rides, half an hour later at 6:00 am. Four to five hours, more relaxed than Gainey Thursday but still a drop ride, and it ends at coffee. The route changes every week and the time changes with the season: the ride's Instagram posts the route, and the Strava event shows the next date without a login.
